title: Compliance evidence synthesis router and control matrix for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 automation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Deliver a synthesis router and canonical control matrix that automates mapping between SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls and evidence collectors across data residency and retention boundaries. The router will ingest structured artifacts from collectors (logs, bucket manifests, audit exports, console snapshots, retention-policy-records) and synthesize attestable evidence bundles with provenance metadata. Key capabilities: 1) a machine-readable control matrix (controls -> required artifacts -> acceptance criteria), 2) a synthesis router that normalizes collector outputs and produces time-stamped evidence bundles, 3) retention mapping that enforces policy windows per customer region (EU/US/APAC) and produces audit-ready manifests, 4) automated reporting endpoints for SOC 2/ISO auditors (CSV + signed JSON + link to raw artifacts), and 5) UI hooks for the Console to show evidence status per control and to trigger on-demand re-collection. Acceptance criteria: - Control matrix covers initial SOC 2 common criteria + top ISO 27001 Annex A controls we claim. - Router returns evidence bundle with provenance for 95% of collectors in scope. - Evidence manifests include sequenced artifact references, retention policy label, and immutable timestamp. - End-to-end pipeline demonstrated for a sample customer with EU data residency and a 2-year retention setting. Out of scope for this ticket: implementation of new collectors (those are separate ENG tickets), deep cryptographic signing (P0 follow-up), and enterprise policy UI polish (tracked separately).
